proposal.text: DECISION 1: YES, the default of CHATROOM_MAX_ROOMS_PER_RUN should stay at 12. Evidence: src/hub.ts:62 reads it from the environment (`?? 12`), so any run can raise it without a code change. src/hub.ts:98-101 counts only OPEN rooms that share a swarm-<id> prefix, so concluding a room frees a slot. skills/swarm/SKILL.md:86 already has operators raise it via env (=40) together with MAX_LIVE_PER_ROOM (default 12 at src/hub.ts:63, =80 via env). That shows the defaults are deliberately conservative and the env var is the intended knob. No script, test or decision in the repo asks for a different default.
